P47 magenta entity viewer contact sheet

One race model rendered LARGE against a solid magenta (255,0,255) clear color, no zone/object geometry, at four fixed angles, deterministic pose (frame 26, i.e. simTime = 26*33.3ms). Reading rule: magenta visible inside the model's silhouette = an alpha gap (a masked texture's palette-index-0 cutout rendering correctly -- see refactor/P37_entity_texture_masked.md's ground-truth table and refactor/P47_magenta_entity_viewer.md). magenta_in_bbox below is the enclosed-magenta pixel count computed by tools/hwcaps/zone_bench_entity_viewer.cpp's border-flood-fill (topologically enclosed magenta = a hole; ordinary background beside a non-convex silhouette is excluded -- see that file's analyzeSilhouette() comment for why a naive whole-bbox count was rejected). Masked races: SKE 21, ZOM 70, BAT 34, ORC 17 (P37 ground truth, all with real ETC1 companion alpha). Unmasked control: Human 1 (must show EXACTLY zero at every angle -- verified by the ctest regression pin, test_entity_viewer_regression).
